description: Fields read from one ICSNPP s7comm.log record (icsnpp-s7comm package) delivered as one Kafka JSON message. Field resolution mirrors the upstream model team's production adapter (two-models-info/S7___/kafka_source.py, normalize_zeek_message): for each canonical field the first present, non-empty alias wins. Integer fields follow upstream's _int_or_none: a JSON integer as is, a boolean as 0/1, a JSON float truncated toward zero, a string parsed as a Python integer literal (decimal, 0x, 0o or 0b) or else as a decimal float truncated toward zero; underscore digit separators are not accepted. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-24-s7comm-stage1-design.md section 5.

requiredFields.name: ts
requiredFields.notes: epoch seconds, fractional part allowed, also accepted as a decimal string; negative, non-finite or year-2300-and-later values are rejected (INVALID_TIMESTAMP). No s7comm-feature-v1 feature reads time: ts orders records, stamps the event id's ts_millis component, and flags an out-of-order record

requiredFields.name: uid
requiredFields.notes: Zeek uid; the connection state key (sensor, uid) and part of the event id. Required, unlike upstream, which falls back to an endpoint flow key: Zeek always writes it (design ruling R1)

requiredFields.name: pdu_reference
requiredFields.notes: aliases pdu_ref, pdu_ref_num. 0-65535, the S7 header's 16-bit PDU reference: request/response matching, the outstanding set and PDU uniqueness. Required, unlike upstream (design ruling R2)

optionalFields.name: source_h
optionalFields.notes: aliases src_h, src. PER-PACKET sender of THIS record. When source_h, source_p, destination_h and destination_p are all present they are used as they are, and the connection pair below is ignored (upstream's precedence)

optionalFields.name: destination_h
optionalFields.notes: aliases dst_h, dst. Per-packet receiver of THIS record

optionalFields.name: destination_p
optionalFields.notes: alias dst_p. Per-packet receiver port; destination port 102 makes the record a request

optionalFields.name: id_orig_h
optionalFields.notes: CONNECTION-level originator, identical on a request and on its response. Accepted spellings, first present wins: id_orig_h (what this platform's sensor emits), id.orig_h (Zeek's dotted JSON), a nested id object's orig_h, and orig_h. Used only when the per-packet four are incomplete, and then oriented by is_orig

optionalFields.name: id_resp_h
optionalFields.notes: CONNECTION-level responder; same spellings and use as id_orig_h

optionalFields.name: is_orig
optionalFields.notes: whether the connection originator sent THIS record: true -> source = orig, destination = resp; false -> the reverse. Required when the connection pair resolves the endpoints. Accepted as a JSON boolean, a number (0 = false), or one of true t 1 yes y orig originator / false f 0 no n resp responder (any case, surrounding spaces ignored); anything else is rejected, as upstream raises

optionalFields.name: rosctr_code
optionalFields.notes: alias rosctr. 0 <= n < 2^24. Source for s7_rosctr and s7_rosctr_change_rate_16; absent -> the __MISSING__ category

optionalFields.name: function_code
optionalFields.notes: alias function. 0 <= n < 2^24. Source for s7_operation and every request-function feature

optionalFields.name: function_name
optionalFields.notes: used only when function_code is absent: upper-cased and mapped back to its code if it is one of upstream's FUNCTION_NAMES, else the unseen-name code -2. Empty is the same as absent

excludedRawFields.name: rosctr_name
excludedRawFields.notes: the frozen s7_rosctr stores the code category, not the name (upstream spec section 2.2, feature 15)

excludedRawFields.name: subfunction_code
excludedRawFields.notes: not an input to either frozen model

excludedRawFields.name: subfunction_name
excludedRawFields.notes: not an input to either frozen model

excludedRawFields.name: error_class
excludedRawFields.notes: not an input to either frozen model

excludedRawFields.name: error_code
excludedRawFields.notes: not an input to either frozen model

excludedRawFields.name: parameter_length, data_length, item_count, varspec_syntax_id, item_transport_size, item_length, db_number, area_code, address_bit, address_byte, address_bit_offset, data_return_code, data_transport_size, data_length_value, data_value_hex, write_value_hex
excludedRawFields.notes: PCAP research fields, excluded from both frozen models (upstream spec section 6.1)

invalidRecordPolicy: Input that is not a single JSON object routes to the s7comm DLQ as MALFORMED_JSON (parse stage). A missing uid, ts or pdu_reference, an unreadable is_orig, or unresolvable or blank endpoints is MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD; an unreadable or out-of-range ts is INVALID_TIMESTAMP; an unreadable or out-of-range port is INVALID_PORT; an unreadable or out-of-range pdu_reference, rosctr_code or function_code is INVALID_COUNTER (all map stage). Unknown additive fields are tolerated and ignored.
